surveyImmediately.description: Enter "true" to survey immediately to bypass checks, otherwise "false"

aiMetadata.description: Dispatches a Wootric (InMoment) NPS email survey to a list of end-user email addresses. Use this to send/send-out customer satisfaction surveys to specific recipients. Set survey-immediately to true to bypass Wootric eligibility/throttle checks and send right away, or false to respect them. Not idempotent: each call sends new survey emails, so repeating it re-sends to the same recipients.
